verdict.rationale: Viam documents a Registry that supplies hardware drivers. You specify a model in config and viam-server pulls the driver from the Registry and initializes it automatically (viam-docs-27, viam-docs-55). Models are searchable by manufacturer or hardware type, such as viam:ufactory:xArm6 (viam-docs-36), and pricing lists "Pre-built modules or build your own" (viam-docs-29). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reusable behavior or logic modules (not just hardware drivers) can be pulled from the Registry, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Registry experience.
